name: @chakerben/maestro
description: Maestro 5 — Claude Code plugin marketplace. Business-layer framework for web & mobile development (RTL/Arabic-native). Install via: claude plugin marketplace add chakerben/maestro-v5

scripts.test: node scripts/check-versions.js && node scripts/validate.js && node scripts/context-budget.js && bash scripts/tests/bash-guard.test.sh && bash scripts/tests/memory-sync.test.sh && bash scripts/tests/secret-scan.test.sh
scripts.test:platform: for p in plugins/*; do claude plugin validate --strict "$p" || exit 1; done
